focal_claim_rationale.description: The abstract and summary emphasize the adverse hierarchy-survival relationship. Keep steepness and sameness separately assessable. Officer favoritism is a central tested explanation; the market mechanism is explicitly interpretive.

paper_level_aggregation_proposal.description: Report the core direction and inference for C01 and C02 across the eight Table 4 specifications, separately for captured/camp and simple/controlled models. Report C03 magnitude, C11 officer evidence and C15 mechanism limitations separately. Do not invent a numerical pass fraction or turn lack of significance into proof of no effect; the article supplies no paper-level scoring rule.
